# Fish-X

> The #1 social app for anglers — find spots, log catches, compete in tournaments, win real money, and meet fishing buddies (or dates).

Fish-X is a fishing-first social platform for anglers 13+. Members log catches, share trips, follow buddies and team pages, climb species leaderboards, and enter live photo and bracket tournaments with cash prizes. An optional dating mode (18+) lets anglers match with people who share the passion.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and signup.
- [Fishing](/fishing): Spots, catches, leaderboards, teams, tournaments.
- [Dating](/dating): Optional dating mode for anglers 18+.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Premium, and Pro plans.
- [Challenges](/challenges): Live photo and fishing challenges.
- [Stories](/stories): Community angler stories.
- [About](/about): Mission and team.
- [Safety](/safety): Safety center and best practices.
- [Help](/help): Help center and FAQs.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Fish-X team.
- [Community Guidelines](/guidelines): Conduct rules.
